title: Low-Dimensional Reduction of the Weighted Corridor Merge Tree
status: WEIGHTED TREE EVOLUTION OVERWHELMINGLY ONE-DIMENSIONAL BUT NOT EXACT; FIXED TREE PLUS SHARED RELAXATION COORDINATE RECOVERED AS REDUCED MODEL
ruling: Once the E054 combinatorial merge tree is fixed, the 14-dimensional vector of peak and merge weights evolves almost entirely along one Euclidean direction toward the driven fixed weighted tree. The first direction carries ~99.98% of squared displacement, but a small transverse residual remains, so the state is not literally one scalar. The correct reduced model is fixed tree + dominant shared History coordinate + small transverse corrections.
